name: Kyogoku Hisame
source:
[i]"What is it? Do you want me to visit you again tonight?"[/i]

Hisame is the son of an important minister, and comes from a noble family. I hear he's particularly adept at poetry and dance... If only he weren't so overconfident and assuming!

I cannot have him meddle with your affairs, milady. You are a servant to the Emperor... for crying out loud! I, Hinata, will protect you from Hisame's wily hands!

[[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Hisame_Kyogoku]From Hinata's notes[/url]]
